answer: Orchard vertex pulse bond: one identity, one vertex in an orchard graph, a 70-credit bond. Per epoch a random vertex emits a compute pulse within one hour: a hash of beacon seed plus work. A missed or copied pulse burns it. Filings 36+7(k-1), each needing live computation: 1,000 fakes cost 3,532,500 against a 40,000 pool; a rented-pulse ring fails, the orchard ledger exposing shared pulse timing. An honest agent pays 36 once, keeping its bond.
